# DS-03: Data Cleaning and Data Quality (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** Missingness, inconsistency, deduplication, record linkage, validation rules and data-quality reporting.

Pick **any one**. Every assessment here is an independent, complete demonstration of this unit at this tier.

- **[DS-T1-006](DS-T1-006-the-registry-that-lies/README.md): The Registry That Lies: Forensic Cleaning of a Student Records Export.** Profile and clean a deliberately corrupted university registry export. Recover what can be recovered, flag what cannot, consolidate duplicates without merging namesakes, and detect a hidden systemic grading-scale defect from data.
- **[DS-T1-007](DS-T1-007-bags-basins-and-tonnes/README.md): Bags, Basins and Tonnes: Harmonising a Smallholder Harvest Survey.** Convert a smallholder harvest survey recorded in bags, basins, mudus and tonnes to kilograms with crop-specific factors and uncertainty bounds, flag implausible yields with robust rules, and investigate how much each cleaning decision changes the production total.
- **[DS-T1-008](DS-T1-008-stuck-drifting-spiking/README.md): Stuck, Drifting, Spiking: Validation Rules for a Low-Cost Air-Quality Network.** Implement exactly specified validation rules for five low-cost PM2.5/temperature/humidity monitors in Lagos: range, stuck-value and Hampel spike checks, robust clock-drift estimation, gap detection, a bitmask quality-flag scheme and completeness-aware hourly means.
